construction.source_proof:
FORCED CAP-ROW EXCHANGE TRANSFER

Transfer the derived AP6 operation, not its numerical translation. The
3-by-3-by-4 parent is the exact two-frame square source for AP4 or AP12.
Choose one middle row in a complete layer, retain its three frames, shift
it by a common q, and append the alternating endpoint owner. Its four
coordinates are (-1,0,1,2)*d+q. Every host wall gives one inequality in q;
intersect them to obtain the full allowed interval, then test all actual
pair facets and the common initial/final rows. No angle is a variable.

At the half-row anchor q=-d/2, same-row contacts are inherited. Adjacent
unchanged rows have y-offset ±d and x-offset (n+1/2)d. Only n=-1,0 can be
close: all remaining offsets have |x|>=3d/2>2R. Rows at distance two or
more have |y|>=2d>2R. The eight ordered near pairs (both source frames,
both y signs, n=-1,0 with target type=source+n+1 mod2) are checked against
the complete exact difference-body palette. AP4's enclosing-circle
estimate is insufficient, so this literal pair test is essential.

The four independent layer choices share one fixed vertical phase H/2.
All cross-layer pairs retain full-H separation. This transfer tests only
the two actual axial row directions and the four existing layers of this
source block, with full wall-derived translation intervals. A missing
interval or incompatible pair is a retained control, not a global bound.

AP4 complete repair: the naive square-source cap has four invalid unchanged owners. Preserve that control. The exact proper host symmetry S=Rz(pi/4)diag(1,-1,-1) fixes each actual owner vertex set. The upper middle layer uses the original square grid; the upper cap is S applied to the valid original lower cap. Reflect these two layers through the SAME host symmetry to supply the lower middle and lower cap. This is a complete36-owner parent atscale4. Apply the forced upper middle row translation q and its S-image to the lower middle row, then append each alternating endpoint owner. All38 owners fit; all layers retain full-H separators. The symmetry is exact and derived from the host/owner vertex permutation, not an angle search.

contribution.method:
This batch contains 32 fresh campaign cases: 27 strict nominal improvements and five improved native certificates for AP12 self-host constructions already known at nominal scale 4. The five certificate reductions are identified separately in the manifest; they are not claimed as new nominal bounds.

The constructions use exact balanced like/unlike antiprism row contacts and marked finite returns, whole-height layer words and vacancy returns, whole-block translations, whole-prism axial subdivisions, and the declared Catalan source-cell returns. Complete source geometry, inherited author credits, marks, frames, all host walls, pair separators and common restoration paths are retained. Classical mechanisms and published source authors retain their attribution; finite construction credit is PingYou Ltd.

The eight-owner AP4 self-host construction has exact feasible scale 42 - 28 sqrt(2). Its complete endpoint and a six-wall/five-pair contact circuit were independently verified. That circuit proves optimality for the declared fixed contact map only; no global optimum is claimed.

All 32 packaged records pass both verify_general.py and certify_general.py (64 checks), independent full geometry/source reviews, current public and retained-construction comparisons, and archive checksum/privacy/dependency checks. The trusted batch parser selects exactly 32 native candidates. Final comparison: repository dc0d6f3bea4c1a5d3ca1845dd1793fd5d9a19828 and site build 2026-10-15 11:27. Thirty cases were previously unheld by PingYou in the selected site records; two improve already-held cases. Submission does not itself establish acceptance.
